desc: Implement exact cube-root bound and integer-square-root checks without floating-point errors.
Enumerate candidate differences \(d\), solve the discriminant condition, and recover positive \(x,y\).
Verify complexity and integer overflow considerations.
Handle input parsing, output, and the no-solution case.
Test provided samples and edge cases including \(N=1\), small valid solutions, and values near \(10^{18}\).
